#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <algorithm>

int main() {
    int n, b;
    std::cin >> n >> b;
    std::vector<int> a(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        std::cin >> a[i];
    }

    std::vector<int> bal(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (i == 0) {
            bal[i] = (a[i] % 2 == 0) ? 1 : -1;
        } else {
            bal[i] = bal[i - 1] + ((a[i] % 2 == 0) ? 1 : -1);
        }
    }

    std::priority_queue<int, std::vector<int>, std::greater<int>> pq;
    for (int i = 1; i < n - 1; ++i) {
        if (bal[i] == 0) {
            pq.push(std::abs(a[i + 1] - a[i]));
        }
    }

    int answer = 0;
    while (!pq.empty() && b >= pq.top()) {
        b -= pq.top();
        pq.pop();
        ++answer;
    }

    std::cout << answer << "\n";

    return 0;
}
